data.title: Wet Personal Lubricant Multipack (1 Fl Oz (Pack of 3))
data.bulletPoints: THREE PREMIUM FORMULAS: Includes water-based, silicone-based, and water-silicone hybrid lubricants for a versatile, silky-smooth experience tailored to your needs. | WATER-BASED FORMULA: Hypoallergenic lubricant that moisturizes and rejuvenates the skin, enhancing your body’s natural moisture for smooth, effortless pleasure. | SILICONE-BASED FORMULA: Pure 4-blend silicone formula delivers an ultra-slippery glide that lasts without sticky residue. A little goes a long way, so no interruptions are needed. | WATER-SILICONE HYBRID FORMULA: Combines the lightweight feel of water-based lubes with the long-lasting glide of silicone for a luxurious, silky-smooth texture. | PROUDLY MADE IN THE USA: Manufactured under strict FDA guidelines, Wet Lubes are proudly made in the USA with trusted quality for over 35 years. While the packaging might change, the silky magic inside stays the same.
